title: T09 — First ledger-covered run of every common pack and the expensive system cases
goal: First runs recorded in the ledger for the common packs neutral-smoke (10), neutral-smoke-schema (10) and general-assistant-expanded (28, never run in NERV), on the authorized Gemma profile, and for the expensive NERV system cases nerv-system-flows/stress and nerv-system-flows/browser. The 2026-11-09 smoke run predates the ledger and its report is not in the repository; the owner may supply that report to `npm run gauntlet:ledger` instead of a rerun.
acceptance: Owner approves the budget; `npm run gauntlet:all -- --profile=… --allow-models --allow-expensive --execute --out-dir=…` runs the 48 model cases and the two expensive system cases
Saved private reports; a summary in docs/evaluations with pass/fail per case, telemetry gaps explicit and no qualification claim
The ledger records every run, and `npm run check:gauntlet-runs` reports nothing pending
privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and private local reports only; no secrets, downloads or production effects.
validation: Report admitted by the pinned Gauntlet release; summary numbers match the report
escalation: Owner action: approve and start the real-model campaign (first smoke: 10 cases in about 65 s, so 48 cases are expected in a few minutes) and the expensive system cases

effort.basis: Owner request 2026-11-11: NERV always consumes every common Gauntlet pack plus its own, and a pack added or changed raises a run-new-tests item. Estimate, not a measurement.
